herb_nettle: still life: a fresh bunch of dark green stinging nettles tied with bast lying on a dark scarred wooden table beside a thick leather glove, lit by one candle.
herb_mint: still life: sprigs of fresh mint in a small clay cup of water on a dark windowsill, drops on the leaves, cold moonlight behind.
herb_plantain: still life: broad ribbed plantain leaves laid over a scraped knee wrapped in a strip of linen, a few more leaves on the grass beside.
herb_thistle: still life: a tall spiny purple thistle head and its jagged leaves nailed above a low doorway of a log hut, cobwebs beside it.
herb_chamomile: still life: a small heap of dried chamomile flowers in a wooden bowl on a dark table, a few scattered beside a clay cup of pale steaming tea.
herb_yarrow: still life: flat white heads of yarrow tied in a bundle and hanging head-down from a rafter, a linen bandage stained dark red folded below.
herb_henbane: still life: a pale sticky henbane plant with veined yellow-grey flowers growing from a cracked human skull half buried in black earth.
herb_valerian: still life: knotted pale valerian roots drying on a cloth on a dark table, a sleeping grey cat curled against them, lit by one candle.
herb_st_john: still life: bright yellow St John's wort flowers in a bundle on a dark table, a few crushed and bleeding dark red sap onto a white cloth.
herb_wolfsbane: still life: tall hooded blue-violet wolfsbane flowers growing among rocks at the forest edge, the print of a wolf's paw in the mud in front.
herb_mandrake: still life: a freshly dug mandrake root shaped like a small twisted human figure lying on black earth beside a wooden spade, its leaves limp.
herb_adam_head: still life: a rare pale root shaped like a small skull hanging on a red thread from a nail in a log wall, a candle burning beneath it.
n_torch: close-up of a hand holding up a burning pitch torch in a black forest, the real flame lighting pale faces between the trunks that draw back from it.
n_rye_bread: still life: a dark round loaf of rye bread broken in half on a linen cloth beside a pinch of coarse salt and a wooden cup, lit by one candle.
n_axe: still life: a woodcutter's axe with a worn ash handle sunk deep into a chopping block, split logs around it, mist and black spruces behind.
n_cloak: a traveller wrapped to the eyes in a heavy patched woollen cloak walking into driving rain on a forest road, the wet cloth shedding the water.
n_sling: close-up of a hand whirling a leather sling with a smooth river stone in the pouch, the cords a blur, a hunched pale creature in the distance.
n_halt: a peasant militiaman in a quilted coat standing in the middle of a forest road with his palm thrust out and a spear grounded, a tall shape stopping before him.
n_pinch_of_salt: close-up of fingers throwing a pinch of coarse salt over a shoulder, the grains caught in candlelight, a small dark imp behind flinching away.
n_pitchfork: a frightened villager in a sheepskin coat bracing a three-tined pitchfork against the chest of a lunging grey ghoul in a barn doorway.
n_campfire: a small campfire burning in a ring of stones in a night forest, cloaks and packs laid around it, the darkness beyond the firelight full of faint watching eyes.
n_prayer: an old peasant woman on her knees in a dark hut with her hands clasped and her head bowed before a small carved wooden idol on a shelf, one candle burning.
n_map_scrap: still life: a torn scrap of birch bark with a rough charcoal drawing of a river, three trees and a cross mark, held flat on a stump by a knife.
n_cudgel: still life: a heavy knotted oak cudgel studded with a few iron nails leaning by a hut door, a dark stain on the head.
n_holy_water: close-up of a hand flicking drops of water from a small clay flask with a bundle of twigs onto a hissing recoiling grey creature.
n_silver_knife: still life: a slim knife with a bright silver blade and a bone handle lying on black cloth, the blade reflecting a full moon.
n_horn_call: a villager on a log watchtower at dusk blowing a long curved cattle horn toward the forest, torches being lit in the village below.
n_bear_trap: still life: a rusty iron bear trap with jagged jaws set open and half hidden under dead leaves on a forest path, a chain running to a tree.
n_last_coin: close-up of a single worn silver coin lying in the middle of an open calloused palm, an empty leather purse hanging from the wrist.
n_wayside_cross: a tall weathered wooden wayside cross with a small roof at a forest crossroads at dusk, a wreath and ribbons tied to it, mist around its foot.
n_fire_arrow: an archer in a hood drawing a bow with an arrow wrapped in burning tow, the real flame lighting his cheek, a dark shape among trees ahead.
n_shared_flask: close-up of a leather flask being passed from one mittened hand to another over a small fire, breath steaming in the cold.
n_straw_man: a straw man in an old coat and hat propped on a pole at the edge of a camp at night, a pale creature clawing at it while travellers slip away behind.
n_whetted_scythe: close-up of a whetstone being drawn along the long curved blade of a scythe, a bright line of fresh edge, rye stubble behind.
n_lookout: a boy sitting high in the fork of a tall pine at dawn shading his eyes with his hand, looking out over a sea of mist and treetops.
n_pectoral_cross: close-up of a small worn wooden cross on a leather cord lying on a traveller's chest over a coarse shirt, his hand closing around it.
n_firebird_ash: still life: a small heap of fine ash in a clay bowl that still glows gold and orange at its heart, one long bright feather lying across the rim.
n_sword_from_stone: an old straight sword standing upright with its blade sunk in a mossy boulder in a forest clearing, a shaft of moonlight on the hilt.
n_feast: a long plank table in a log hall crowded with bowls of porridge, roast fowl, loaves and jugs, villagers and weary travellers eating shoulder to shoulder by torchlight.
n_alarm_bell: a bronze alarm bell hanging in a wooden frame at a village gate being rung hard by a woman hauling on the rope, crows scattering, dusk sky.
n_wanderer: a lone old wanderer with a long staff, a bag over his shoulder and bast shoes walking away down a forest road at sunrise, long shadow behind him.
n_old_oath: close-up of two old scarred hands clasped over the hilt of a rusted sword stuck in the ground, grey beards and faded cloaks behind, out of focus.
